items.exampleEn: Nobody likes to be called a hypocrite.
items.exampleZh: 沒有人喜歡被叫作偽君子。

items.exampleEn: Not every act of giving is truly altruistic.
items.exampleZh: 並不是所有付出的行為都是純粹無私的。

items.exampleEn: Their whole business was built on deceit.
items.exampleZh: 他們整個生意都是建立在欺騙之上。

items.exampleEn: The final match was riveting from start to finish.
items.exampleZh: 決賽從頭到尾都精彩得讓人目不轉睛。
items.glossZh: 引人入勝的；精彩吸引人的

items.exampleEn: Her disillusionment with city life led her to move to the coast.
items.exampleZh: 她對城市生活的幻滅，讓她搬到了海邊。

items.exampleEn: The puzzle engrossed the children for hours.
items.exampleZh: 那個拼圖讓孩子們全神貫注地玩了好幾個小時。

items.exampleEn: Enterprising farmers in the area now sell their fruit online.
items.exampleZh: 這一帶有創業頭腦的農民，現在都在網路上賣水果。
items.glossZh: 有進取心的；有創業頭腦的

items.exampleEn: I detest waiting in long lines.
items.exampleZh: 我非常討厭排長長的隊。

items.sentenceEn: The documentary about deep-sea fish was absolutely riveting.
items.sentenceZh: 那部關於深海魚類的紀錄片精彩極了。

items.audioEn: I was so engrossed in my book that I missed my stop on the train.
items.audioZh: 我看書看得太入迷，結果搭火車坐過站了。
options: The speaker fell asleep after a long day

items.sentenceEn: Some scientists believe that dolphins can show altruistic behavior.
items.sentenceZh: 有些科學家認為，海豚會表現出利他的行為。

items.sentenceEn: She detests people who talk loudly on their phones.
items.sentenceZh: 她非常討厭講手機很大聲的人。

items.stemEn: The investigation revealed years of ____ by the company's managers.
items.stemZh: 調查揭露了這家公司的經理們多年來的欺騙行為。

items.stemEn: I was so ____ in the film that I forgot to eat my popcorn.
items.stemZh: 我看電影看得太投入，連爆米花都忘了吃。

items.passageEn: At nineteen, Kai joined a charity that promised to build schools in poor villages. He was full of altruistic hopes. Within months, however, disillusionment set in. To his dismay, he discovered that the director had used donations to buy himself a new car. Kai detested deceit, and he felt the director was a hypocrite who talked about kindness while thinking only of himself. Instead of giving up, the enterprising young man started his own small project, teaching village children to read on weekends. Later, he wrote a book about the experience. Readers found it riveting, and many said they were so engrossed that they finished it in one night.
items.passageZh: Kai 十九歲時加入一個慈善機構，對方承諾要在貧窮的村莊蓋學校。他滿懷無私的理想。然而不到幾個月，理想就幻滅了。他沮喪地發現，負責人用捐款替自己買了一輛新車。Kai 痛恨欺騙，覺得那位負責人是個偽君子，嘴上說著善良，心裡只想著自己。這個有進取心的年輕人沒有放棄，而是自己發起一個小計畫，每到週末就教村裡的孩子讀書。後來，他把這段經歷寫成一本書。讀者覺得這本書非常吸引人，很多人說他們讀得太入迷，一個晚上就讀完了。

questions.questionZh: Kai 發現負責人做了什麼？
options: 把學校蓋在離村子很遠的地方
偷偷把慈善機構賣給別的公司

questions.questionZh: 讀者怎麼評價 Kai 的書？
options: 寫得很好，但價格實在太貴了
內容太悲傷，很多人讀不下去
非常吸引人，一晚就讀完

items.promptZh: 他嘴上說要省錢，自己卻天天買新衣服，真是個偽君子！
referenceEn: He talks about saving money but buys new clothes every day. What a hypocrite!
He tells everyone to save money, yet he buys new clothes every day; he is such a hypocrite!
rubricZh: 「偽君子」用 hypocrite，可寫 What a hypocrite!、He is such a hypocrite! 等
「嘴上說⋯卻⋯」可寫，例如 talks about…but…、tells everyone to…yet… 等
說的是習慣，時態配合內容（例如 talks、buys）

items.promptZh: 幾個有進取心的學生在校園裡開了一家二手書店。
referenceEn: A few enterprising students opened a second-hand bookshop on campus.
Some enterprising students started a used bookshop on campus.
rubricZh: 「有進取心的」用 enterprising（例如 enterprising students 等）
「開了」可寫，例如 opened、started、set up 等
「二手書店」可寫，例如 a second-hand bookshop、a used bookstore 等
時態配合內容（例如 opened、have opened 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似一眼排除（干擾項詞性與其他選項不同）
